rules: Parse explicit Markdown L1/L2 headings and L3 bullet ordering only; do not infer Feature IDs.
Do not infer hierarchy from feature names, APIs, Payload collections, or database tables.
Historical output is reconciliation evidence only and cannot directly populate the formal Capability Contract Graph.

nodes.l3: no synchronous high-frequency write amplification without exception
no content-like object without content/IP/rights mapping where applicable
no derived index treated as source of truth
no feature without cost and acceptance criteria
